contentText: Argentine President Javier Milei said he would sanction oil companies drilling in the Falkland Islands, the British overseas territory claimed by Argentina, in a move which could escalate tensions with London. Milei's comments in a televised national ​address on Thursday came ‌days after US President Donald Trump said he was reviewing the United States' neutral position on the ⁠remote archipelago in the South Atlantic.
